scope_notes: Original source archives; not yet converted into simulator reference layers.
SoilGrids is provider-resampled at 0.25 degree, mean 0-5 cm only, 60S-85N; not area averages.
WorldCover and JRC surface water are regional examples; MOD17 is one global annual snapshot (2020).
GEOROC includes five selected rock types; USMIN includes the lithium release only.
GRDC WMO 2024 release is CC BY-NC 4.0: noncommercial reference use only.
Point occurrences are biased observations, not exhaustive distributions or confirmed absences.
All archives stay compressed; the collection cap does not cover later extraction or processing.
GBIF data is a coarse occurrence-record density map for observation coverage; it does not encode species distributions or true biodiversity.
